function.description: Declare a function — `name(args):`; `name():` for no parameters

main.description: Special main block — runs automatically when reached

return.description: Return a value from a function

while.description: while loop (pre-test, may run zero times)

for-range.description: for loop over `range(stop)` — stop is exclusive

for-collection.description: for loop over a collection/string variable

switch.description: switch with a constant case and the optional wildcard case (must be last)

function-variadic.description: 2B: function with *args (extra positionals yield a list) and **kwargs (extra named arguments yield a map)

function-nested.description: 2B: nested function — a closure, legal inside a function body or main:

global.description: 2B: global declaration — `global name` or `global a, b`; later assignments target the module global (must precede any binding or use of the name)

nonlocal.description: 2B: nonlocal declaration — `nonlocal name` or `nonlocal a, b`; rebinds the nearest enclosing function's binding (from a nested function)

class.description: 2C: class block (top level or main:) with methods; fields are assigned dynamically on instances

init.description: 2C: constructor — called as `Class(args)` with the instance prepended; return value discarded

try-except.description: 2C: try/except with an `as` binding (bare `except:` catches everything; matching is exact class identity)

raise.description: 2C: raise an exception instance (re-raise via the `as` binding) or a bare builtin exception class

variable.description: 0.2.1 cross-scope access (docs/reference/cross-scope-access.md): `variable.global n` = module global, `variable.parent n` = enclosing function's binding, `variable.<fn> n` = sibling/self function's binding — no `global`/`nonlocal` declaration needed

open-loop.description: 0.2.1: open a file, iterate its lines, close it (methods: read/readline/readlines/write/writelines/seek/tell/flush/close; `next(f)` reads one line — SPEC §5.11.3)

sorted.description: 0.2.1: sorted list (stable merge sort) — `sorted(it, key=fn, reverse=…)`; `key` is a named function declaration, no lambdas (SPEC §5.11.3)

isinstance.description: 0.2.1: exact-type test — bare builtin-type names (`int`, `text`, …) or type-name strings (`"int"`); tuples allowed; no subclassing (SPEC §5.11.5)

http-get.description: HTTP GET via libcurl — `http_get(url[, headers])` returns text "STATUS\nBODY" (status 0 + curl error text on connection failure); `headers` is an optional text of one `Name: value` line each

http-post.description: HTTP POST via libcurl — `http_post(url, body[, headers])` sends `body` as JSON (default Content-Type: application/json) and returns text "STATUS\nBODY"; `headers` is an optional text of one `Name: value` line each

url-encode.description: Percent-encode text for a query string / form body — unreserved `A-Z a-z 0-9 - _ . ~` stay literal, every other UTF-8 byte becomes `%XX` (uppercase hex)
